title: Aquinas's mystical experience at mass

tellings.quote: St. Thomas Aquinas was like working on his Summa Theologica this like rational explanation of of God and I think he had this conversion, you know, kind of moment while he was in mass

plain: Thomas Aquinas, the medieval Catholic thinker, is said to have had a sudden spiritual awakening during mass while writing the Summa Theologica, his long effort to explain God through reason. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. He uses it to show that even the most rational mind can be changed by a direct mystical experience.
